in_marathi.name: Poovarasan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the River Poova
in_marathi.long_meaning: Poovarasan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over the river Poova. Poovarasan is a popular Hindu name inspired by Lord Shiva, the supreme god in Hinduism. The name is derived from the Tamil words 'poo' meaning river and 'varasan' meaning the ruler. Thus, Poovarasan is a name that signifies power, strength, and the ability to protect.
